description: This file defines a class ContentType that extends another ContentType class, providing methods for creating a converter, adding JavaScript for rendering math and diagrams, and performing content conversion with conditional JavaScript inclusion.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A class extending a Markdown ContentType to add support for Confluence-specific content rendering, including math and diagram support via JavaScript.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CommonMarkConverter instance configured with the current object's config.

methods.name: addJS
methods.description: Returns a string containing JavaScript code to load and render math (KaTeX) and diagrams (Mermaid) in the content.

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Performs content conversion, appends JavaScript if certain config flags are set, and resets those flags.
